author: WPB7
summary: Archived progress log of the superseded two-volume book (July 2026): scope decisions, a content-completeness pass and the two volumes' contents. It is historical; its few technical statements are either on the site (Storage, CNAEXT catalogue, ecosystem map) or false at 009d40f5 (the content resolution order and the meaning of .cnb).

concepts.text: The original request was for about 4,000 pages across two volumes; the project delivered about 220 pages of source-grounded text instead, preferring depth and traceability over page count.
concepts.note: Scope history of the book: a record of how the book was made, with no CNA behaviour to document.

concepts.text: Author scope caps limited free-direct to roughly 5 to 10 pages across both volumes and kept cna-extended to one appendix paragraph.
The early content chapter stated ContentManager's resolution order as .xnb first, then a direct native-format load, then .cnj last as an optional sidecar.

target.evidence: misc/cnj.md and ContentManager::ResolveAssetPath (ContentManager.hpp) at 009d40f5: .xnb, then .cnb, then .cnj, then native extensions; docs/content-manager.html states the current ladder

concepts.note: False at 009d40f5: .cnj is tried before native extensions and a compiled .cnb tier sits between .xnb and .cnj; not carried over.

concepts.text: CNA's JSON sidecar format .cnj was renamed from an earlier, confusingly named .cnb extension.

target.evidence: docs/cnb-format.html (checked at 009d40f5); CNB reader/writer sources under modules/content at 009d40f5

concepts.note: At 009d40f5 .cnb names a different thing: CNA's compiled binary chunk container (optional Zstd), produced by cna-content, documented on docs/cnb-format.html.

concepts.text: Microsoft::Xna::Framework::Storage (StorageDevice, StorageContainer, StorageDeviceNotConnectedException) is implemented and deserves its own treatment.
A curated appendix catalogued the project's NOXNA/EXT extensions by area, explicitly not exhaustive, with the compile-time purity gate as the authoritative check.
concepts.note: NOXNA is now CNAEXT; the site's CNAEXT catalogue separates the marker, the option and the umbrella target.

concepts.text: The ecosystem map covers sibling and consumer repositories (cna-template, cna-extended, meta-gl, cna-samples, cna-examples, the language bindings), each as evidence for its own pinned revision only.
concepts.note: The manuscript's 2026-07 list of small game projects is historical; the site's ecosystem page is the current map.

concepts.section: Volume I — The Core Framework and the Graphics Machine — COMPLETE (112 pages, 24 chapters + 1 appendix)
concepts.text: Volume I's chapter list: ecosystem, building, first game, loop, math, content, graphics device, SpriteBatch, textures, models, effects, state, the .fx gap, and one chapter per then-current renderer backend, plus an API quick reference.
concepts.note: Structure of the superseded two-volume edition; several of its renderer chapters describe renderer families retired since.

concepts.section: Volume II — The Ecosystem, the Platforms, and the Practice — COMPLETE (116 pages, 24 chapters + 5 appendices)
concepts.text: Volume II's chapter list: services (input to storage), sharp-runtime, easy-gl, free-direct, Windows/Web/Android platforms, migration, the Blupi case study, xna4-spec, samples, practice and roadmap, with feature-matrix, glossary, repository-map, extension-catalogue and API appendices.
concepts.note: Structure of the superseded two-volume edition.

concepts.text: Chapters were written from direct reads of source, READMEs, docs and plan files across the CNA ecosystem, partly via parallel research passes, and two documentation-drift corrections (a README media-coverage claim and the book's own stale 'no .xnb reader' text) were kept as worked lessons.
concepts.note: Book method; the current treatment of CNA's own documentation drift is the Known Issues pipeline and the site's evidence rules.

concepts.text: The back-of-book index was empty until \cnaclass/\cnans were made to emit \index entries; cross-volume references used a \newlabel shim.
concepts.note: LaTeX production detail: a record of how the book was made, with no CNA behaviour to document.
